checks: Draft list distinguishes identical headings, edited/missing originals and orders by actual updatedAt
Preview changes no drafts; cancel keeps input DOM, cursor and accepted data
Selected private copy retains exact text/date/URLs; existing post and all local content remain unchanged
Aborted transaction preserves choices and store; retry commits once and exports reusable v1 file
Fresh competing draft prompts another review; merging preserves its edits and intentional duplicate copy
Real second-tab CAS race leaves no partial addition; retry merges the latest data
Invalid, oversized, empty files and full draft storage fail without changing accepted data
Late file read cannot reopen a review after navigation or overwrite a newer chosen file
Exported legacy file is reusable in an independent workspace without touching its original drafts
